import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    MOD = 1000000007
    used = [False] * p
    t = 0

    # iterative DFS using stack
    for i in range(p):
        if not used[i]:
            t += 1
            stack = [i]
            used[i] = True
            while stack:
                x = stack.pop()
                to = (x * k) % p
                if not used[to]:
                    used[to] = True
                    stack.append(to)

    ans = 1
    # exponent = t + (1 if k == 1 else 0) - 1
    exp = t + (1 if k == 1 else 0) - 1
    for _ in range(exp):
        ans = (ans * p) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
